tokens.conditions: Wrapped royalty receipts can be unwrapped into the ETH claim pool.

utility.title: Stake VETERANS NFTs
utility.description: NFT custody staking has no fixed lock. Rewards use staked NFT count and time since this wallet first minted or staked in VETERANS; it is not wallet age.
utility.conditions: Requires the configured staking contract. No guaranteed APY; rewards depend on actual funded balances.

utility.title: Mint-fee and royalty pools
utility.description: Mint payments route 65% to staking, 20% to the claim pool, 10% to treasury and 5% to burn. Received 6.9% royalties split 6.0% to the pool and 0.9% to treasury.
utility.conditions: Age weights refresh on staking actions/claims or permissionless refresh; accrued amounts depend on current weights and actual receipts.

utility.title: Equip and improve a BLACKOUT farm

utility.title: Game mining, not passive NFT staking

utility.conditions: Owning an item alone does not guarantee a payout. The deployed module graph and current game state determine eligibility.
